title: The decision's holdout interval measured on a time split: time_decision_v1
request: The owner, 2026-10-25: measure the time-split interval after tonight's gate (34.1's open end: a time split passes no folds, so its interval is the row-sized one, never measured; the churn replica's first day-by-day reading realised 10.6 against an interval of 4.8 to 8.6).
spec: dclab_rnd/time_decision_measure.py, campaign time_decision_v1: 30 fresh seeds (100 to 129) of the churn replica, split by time, each run twice through the engine: a share capacity read as one pool and one call a day read day by day; fraud_decision_v3's gate per arm (coverage of at least 80% of at least 20 acting seeds, centre, width) plus a time-split check and one holdout read; the next step fixed with the gate; per run the positive rates of the out-of-fold rows, the latest fold and the holdout, and each fold's value.
plan: Copy fraud_decision_v3's campaign shape and gate
Two arms per seed on the same replica
Review the design before the gate freezes
Commit the code, then run from a clean worktree at that commit
Report each arm's verdict and act on the next step fixed with the gate

decisions.decision: Two arms on the same seeds: a share (pooled) and one call a day (day by day)
decisions.why: the share tests the time split's interval itself, the daily arm tests 0.115.0's day-by-day reading on the same rows, so a difference between them belongs to the days

decisions.decision: The gate copied from fraud_decision_v3, judged per arm
decisions.why: the same yardstick that passed on an entity split, so a failure here belongs to the time split

decisions.decision: Record positive rates and each fold's value, never a row value
decisions.why: the review: a realised value above the interval has two possible causes on this replica (its planted drift and the expanding-window fold models' weakness); the counts let the report say which

findings.defect: the split was recorded as None on every run
findings.scenario: a probe of run_one on seed 0: neither final['run'] nor final['evidence'] holds the split
findings.cause: the strategy lives in the data stage's evidence (split_strategy)
findings.fix: read it from the data stage, and a time_split gate so a seed split otherwise never counts toward a time-split verdict

findings.defect: the next step named a cause the campaign could not tell from another
findings.scenario: the churn replica drifts on purpose (later sign-ups leave more: out-of-fold positive rate 0.217, latest fold 0.236, holdout 0.246 over seeds 100-129), so realised above centre is expected from the drift alone; seed 0's probe missed above on both arms
findings.cause: the next step was written as 'the fold models weaker than the final one'
findings.fix: the next step worded as a remedy (read the interval from the latest fold's rows), and each record keeps the three positive rates and each fold's value

findings.defect: the replica's planted traps never labelled the runs' decisions
findings.scenario: fraud_decision_v3 calls labels.from_replica; this campaign dropped it, losing 60 runs' benchmark labels

findings.defect: a run that raised left no record, so the campaign could never reach a verdict
findings.scenario: one seed raising keeps 'complete' false forever, and fixing it changes the code hash the frozen campaign refuses
findings.fix: a failed result is written; the chosen gate counts it

findings.defect: a second run after completion crashed on the verdict file
findings.scenario: the glob TDC-[0-9]*.json matched TDC-900_decision.json, which has no seed
findings.cause: a glob wider than the runs' names

measurements.name: time_decision_v1: 30 fresh seeds of the churn replica (split by time), two arms, on 17cfbd36
measurements.gate: time_decision_gate_v1 per arm: chosen, time split, capacity and one holdout read, coverage of at least 80% of at least 20 acting seeds, |mean z| <= 1.645/sqrt(N), the 90% chi-squared interval of RMS z contains 1
measurements.result: pooled (10% share): fail; chosen, time split, capacity, coverage pass (28 of 30 inside, 2 above), centre fail (mean z 0.80, bound 0.30), width fail (RMS z 1.22, interval 1.01 to 1.55). daily (one call a day): fail; coverage 21 of 30 (0.70, 9 above), mean z 1.00, RMS z 1.45 (1.20 to 1.84). Positive rate out-of-fold 0.217, latest fold 0.236, holdout 0.247; each fold's value (pooled share) 4.81, 5.19, 5.59 against 5.96 realised
limits: one replica with a drift planted on purpose; a table without drift may pass as it is
the per-fold values are read at the chosen share pooled, for both arms

outcome: Measured: on a time split the interval sits low on both arms; the replica's drift explains the direction (each fold's value rises toward the holdout). Next, fixed with the gate: the interval from the latest fold's rows only.
lessons: Before a measurement names a cause in its next step, check whether the test data plants another cause with the same sign
A campaign must write a record for a run that fails, or a frozen campaign can never reach its verdict
An interval built from the past is for a world that stays the same: on a drifting table it says so by missing on one side
risks: The churn replica's drift and the fold models' weakness push the same way; the rates separate them only roughly
